content.summary: Server-managed session model for B2B SaaS with secure cookie storage, refresh token rotation, and tenant-scoped session lifecycle.
invariants: Sessions are always tenant-scoped. A session for workspace A cannot access workspace B.
Refresh token reuse invalidates the entire session family.
Revoked sessions return 401 on the next request, with zero delay.
Session creation requires verified identity (email verification or OAuth callback).
procedures: Create session on successful login. Store session ID, user ID, workspace ID, created_at, expires_at, refresh_token_hash.
On each request, validate session cookie, check expiry, verify workspace scope.
On refresh, rotate the refresh token. Invalidate the old token. Extend session expiry.
On logout, delete the session record. Clear the cookie. Log the event.
On password change, revoke all active sessions for the user.
failureModes: Session fixation. Mitigate by regenerating session ID after login.
Refresh token theft. Mitigate by rotating on every use and invalidating reuse.
Cross-tenant session leakage. Mitigate by binding every session to a workspace ID.
Session storage failure. Mitigate by failing closed — deny access if session cannot be verified.
